title: Event existence does not resolve reimbursement documentation
summary: The official event pages answer whether events existed, not whether county reimbursement packets were complete or compliant.

data.claim: Official event corroboration narrows but does not eliminate the accountability gap because the underlying county approvals, receipts, attendance evidence and itemized business-purpose records were not independently reviewed.
data.adjudication: Obtain primary county records before reaching a compliance conclusion.
